title: CLI Lights
tagline: UART-controlled LEDs using ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS
description: An ESP-IDF learning project that controls three LEDs from a serial command-line interface. Each LED can be turned on, turned off, or made to blink.
problem: Simple LED control is often implemented as an unstructured demo. A clear command task and separate LED tasks make firmware behaviour easier to understand and extend.
objectives: Control three LEDs through a serial menu
Demonstrate FreeRTOS tasks for independent LED control
Share command state between the UART task and LED tasks
architecture: The UART task reads serial input and selects an LED and action. Three independent LED tasks apply the selected mode to their GPIO outputs.

lessons: Task separation makes command handling and output control easier to reason about
Shared task state needs synchronization before the application becomes more complex
UART0 can share the serial interface used for boot output and flashing
future: Replace shared state with a message queue
